title: Come the Way of the Cross
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Come the Way of the Cross | Salvation by Faith, Joy of Salvation, Church Revival, and Eternal Hope - 2 Corinthians v5:21

Jesus Christ has done everything necessary for our salvation, and we must personally respond in faith. From 2 Corinthians v5:21, we see the heart of the gospel: the sinless Son took our sin so that we might receive His righteousness. We cannot stand right with God by good intentions, hard seasons, or a respectable life. We come only by the cross.

There is deep joy in finally surrendering to the Lord and discovering that His grace changes everything. The same God who saves also revives, restores, and blesses lives that are fully yielded to Him. He is no respecter of persons, and what He has done for one He is able to do for another.

Good works and kind reputations cannot secure heaven. Eternal life is received when we _activate_ what Christ has done by faith, trusting in Jesus alone. The cross is not just a story to admire; it is the only way to be forgiven, made righteous, and given everlasting hope.
